run_make_changelog: run the script to collect changelog entries from closed GitHub issues with the needs changelog label
extract_changelog_entries: extract suggested changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the ENTRY regex pattern
list_issues_needing_changelog: list closed GitHub issues labeled needs changelog that are missing a changelog entry
format_changelog_entry: format a changelog message with bullet prefix, period suffix, and issue reference link
print_missing_changelog_template: print the template for contributors to add a suggested changelog entry to their issue
